record.question: Which among the following has become the first country in the world to eliminate leprosy?
record.explanation: Answer C: Jordan. WHO verified Jordan as the first country to eliminate leprosy in September 2024. Reference: https://www.who.int/news/item/19-09-2024-jordan-becomes-first-country-to-receive-who-verification-for-eliminating-leprosy. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Historical context: LDC MPSC Paper-I, February 2025 examination; current affairs interpreted as of paper date.. Officeholders, survey results and forecasts refer to that original paper, not necessarily the present. No matching examiner key is asserted.
